title: Evaluation of Adam's Forward Bend Test and Smartphone Application in Screening of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis
brief_summary: Scoliosis is a lateral curvature of the spine when the Cobb´s angle more than 10˚ on the frontal plane. Curve detection before skeletal maturation gives a good opportunity for early treatment or prevention of curve progression. Purpose of this study was to evaluate Adam's Forward Bend Test and Scoliometer HD in screening of Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age range from 10 to 15 year.
* Males ( parents of girls refused their participation).
* Students who have structural scoliosis.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Congenital deformities.
* Neuromuscular disorder (Cerebral palsy and spinal muscle atrophy).
* Syndromic disorders (Muscular dystrophy, Osteogenesis imperfect and spinabifida).
study_population: Male students with age range 10-15 years
